[[File:SeaLeviathanBlisterPods.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The blister pods of a Sea Leviathan]]

'''Blister pods''' were small nodes that were a powerful part of both the [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathan]], and its aquatic counterpart, the [[Sea Leviathan]], both being forms of [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]]. All leviathans were [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemically]]-engineered [[Superweapon/Legends|bioweapons]], and the blister pods served as their primary means of attack. When a victim was in close proximity of the Leviathan, land or [[Water/Legends|sea]], the blister pods would absorb their life energy, effectively [[Death/Legends|killing]] the victim. In the case of the Sea Leviathan, the blister pods only affected the members of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and did so uniquely, not only absorbing their life force, but their [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] as well. This allowed the Sea Leviathan to become more sentient itself, and also caused it to act and think like its Mon Cal victims.
